mapper.select: SELECT community_account_no, member_no, employee_no, nickname, account_role, community_status, created_at, updated_at FROM TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT WHERE member_no = #{member_no}
SELECT community_account_no, member_no, employee_no, nickname, account_role, community_status, created_at, updated_at FROM TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT ( member_no, nickname, account_role, community_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{member_no}, #{nickname}, #{account_role}, #{community_status}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMUNITY_ACCOUNT SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE community_account_no = #{community_account_no} AND community_status = 'ACTIVE'
